subject: Infra onboarding: MAP, POC env access & peering windows
messages:
From: Chris Moore <chris@quantivehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@quantivehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:14:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for POC — environment requirements

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a short POC. Before we lock calendar time, can you send over a simple MAP that lists the environment items we need to complete on our side (API keys/org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering, expected lead times)? We want to align internal procurement/security review with your onboarding.

Also, rough estimate: how long from "API key requested" to us seeing a working test call? Our security team will need the peering template and expected CIDR ranges.

Appreciate a one-page view we can circulate.

—Chris
Chris Moore
Senior Product Manager
Quantive Health
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Moore <chris@quantivehealth.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@quantivehealth.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for POC — environment requirements

Hi Chris —

Thanks — and great question. I put together an initial MAP snippet (attached) that maps each onboarding task to an owner, typical lead time, and a recommended verification step. High level below so you can circulate quickly:

- Org & API keys (owner: Quantive + Redwood) — lead time: ~1 business day to provision after org confirms admin email; verification: a successful /v1/health API call from an allowed IP.
- IP allowlist (owner: Quantive) — lead time: <1 business day once CIDR(s) provided; verification: curl to /v1/health from allowed IP.
- VPC peering (owner: Quantive + cloud infra) — lead time: 3–5 business days depending on approvals and cloud team bandwidth; verification: small packet test and private endpoint access.
- Test dataset & eval plan (owner: Quantive) — lead time: 2–4 business days to prepare prompts and reference outputs; verification: run eval harness and share metrics.

Attachments I included: quantive_map_v1.xlsx (MAP checklist), vpc-peering-template.pdf, and a short API-key provisioning checklist.

Typical end-to-end for a lean POC (if approvals are timely): 7–10 business days from when you approve the MAP and provide CIDRs + peering contact. If procurement needs extra review or our security questionnaire is requested, add ~5 business days.

I'll loop in Priyom to coordinate the technical steps and Marcus for any quota/reserved capacity questions. Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff on your side for network and security owners next week. What windows do you have?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — East
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Neha/Priyom —

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick notes from our side:
- Security wants the peering template and expected egress CIDRs (we can provide those later today).
- For the API keys, our cloud admin (cc'd) needs the exact format of the request and the admin email to assign.
- Preferred kickoff: Tue 2026-11-30 14:00 ET for network + security sync (30 min). Does that work on your end?

We also attached our internal approval SLA: if a template/answers are provided within 48 hours, we will prioritize the peering ticket.

Samantha Lee

Quantive Health

Folks — forwarding the MAP confirmation from Quantive. Action items for Redwood ops:

1) Prepare short-run API key provisioning (1 admin-owned key + test key) and coordinate naming convention. Owner: Priyom. Target: provision test keys within 1 business day of receiving admin email.
2) Draft a scoped VPC peering playbook specific to AWS (we'll reuse GCP template later). Attach the peering template (see attachments). Owner: Marcus — can you validate CIDR constraints and expected security group rules?
3) Prepare a short checklist we can give Quantive security that lists data retention, logs, and audit endpoints. Owner: Neha.

I'll create tasks in the onboarding board and ping infra slack channel. If Quantive provides CIDR and admin email today (per their SLA) we can hit the 7–10 business day window.

—Priyom
